text: Steep pavment entrance: Subject: Formal Request for Remedial Works to Pavement and Road Level at Driveway Entrance Dear Sir/Madam, I am writing to raise a concern regarding the sudden drop in level between the pavement and the street outside my property at 46 Dunblane Road, SE96RS, where the entrance to my driveway meets the road. I would also be grateful for written confirmation of any proposed action and the expected timescale for addressing this issue. Thank you for your time and consideration. Provide a written response outlining the findings of the inspection, the action the council intends to take, and the expected timescale for completing the necessary works. I can provide photographs of the road conditions and the internal cracking within our property to support this complaint. I would also appreciate confirmation that this complaint has been formally recorded and that a reference number has been provided for future correspondence. Given the potential for further damage to our property, I ask that this matter be treated seriously and investigated as a matter of urgency.
